import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 11,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

conditions = ['IID\n(Crescendo)', 'OOD\n(Decep. Delight)', 'OOD\n(FITD)', 'OOD\n(ActorAttack)']
treatment_f1 = [1.00, 0.997, 1.00, 0.972]
baseline_f1  = [1.00, 0.312, 1.00, 0.258]
tfidf_f1     = [1.00, 0.961, 1.00, 0.261]

colors = {
    'treatment': '#0072B2',
    'baseline': '#D55E00',
    'tfidf': '#009E73',
}

x = np.arange(len(conditions))
bar_width = 0.20
gap = 0.03

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.5))

offsets = [-(bar_width + gap), 0, bar_width + gap]

bars_t = ax.bar(x + offsets[0], treatment_f1, bar_width, color=colors['treatment'], label='DisPeD (ours)', zorder=3)
bars_b = ax.bar(x + offsets[1], baseline_f1, bar_width, color=colors['baseline'], label='Vanilla DeBERTa', zorder=3)
bars_tf = ax.bar(x + offsets[2], tfidf_f1, bar_width, color=colors['tfidf'], label='TF-IDF LR', zorder=3)

def add_labels(bars, values, highlight_idx=None):
    for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars, values)):
        color = 'black'
        weight = 'normal'
        if highlight_idx is not None and i == highlight_idx:
            color = '#C00000'
            weight = 'bold'
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, val + 0.015,
                f'{val:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=8.5, color=color, fontweight=weight, zorder=4)

def add_labels_multi(bars, values, highlight_indices=None):
    if highlight_indices is None:
        highlight_indices = set()
    for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars, values)):
        color = '#C00000' if i in highlight_indices else 'black'
        weight = 'bold' if i in highlight_indices else 'normal'
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, val + 0.015,
                f'{val:.2f}' if val >= 0.01 else f'{val:.2f}',
                ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=7.5, color=color, fontweight=weight, zorder=4)

add_labels_multi(bars_t, treatment_f1)
add_labels_multi(bars_b, baseline_f1, highlight_indices={1, 3})
add_labels_multi(bars_tf, tfidf_f1, highlight_indices={3})

aa_idx = 3
t_bar = bars_t[aa_idx]
b_bar = bars_b[aa_idx]
arrow_x = (t_bar.get_x() + t_bar.get_width() + b_bar.get_x()) / 2
ax.annotate('', xy=(arrow_x, 0.952),
            xytext=(arrow_x, 0.28),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#333333', lw=1.3, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
            zorder=5)
ax.text(arrow_x + 0.06, 0.59,
        '+71pp', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', zorder=5,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.85))

ax.axhline(y=1.0, color='#BBBBBB', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

ax.set_ylim(0, 1.15)
ax.set_ylabel('F1 Score')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(conditions)
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

ax.legend(ncol=3, loc='upper center', framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
          bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.12), columnspacing=0.8, handletextpad=0.4)

plt.tight_layout()

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_2/projects/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_cross_attack_bar.pdf', format='pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_cross_attack_bar.png', format='png')
plt.close()

print('Done: fig2_cross_attack_bar.pdf and .png generated.')
